exposure: type of surgery (gynecological, abdominal, otorhinolaryngological, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 74 HAE patients (46 female, 62.2%) diagnosed between 1999 and 2024 at a tertiary adult allergy clinic who underwent surgical procedures.
finding: Perioperative angioedema occurred in 29.8% of surgeries, and the angioedema rate was similar regardless of preoperative short-term prophylaxis use before cesarean section.
mod_finding: No significant difference in angioedema attack frequency was found between cesarean sections performed with or without short-term prophylaxis (27.3% vs 18.2%, p = 0.611).
